why: Acceptance criterion of #25: a benign finding is flagged as a likely false positive. The scanner only guessed common DKIM selectors, the domain sends through Mailgun (which names its own selectors), and DMARC rejects mail without strict DKIM alignment, which a working domain could not survive without DKIM.

findings.title: No DKIM selector found
findings.description: None of the probed DKIM selectors publishes a key, so mail from the domain likely carries no DKIM signature. Only common selectors are probed, so this is a hint, not proof that DKIM is absent.
